                             | Create the solution file and requested .NET app project with the agreed names, paths, archetype, and template, then ensure the solution contains the app project before this step completes. Do not cite project-media file paths as source document context unless they are present in current launch variables, current prompt context, inherited upstream artifacts, or current-run tool receipts. Write the primary scaffold artifact using only grounded external-target aliases, managed process refs, project-structure node ids, and current-run tool receipt refs; do not write native absolute paths, scoped storage paths under artifacts/scopes/..., tool-run stdout/stderr paths, managed-files paths, project-media paths, or SourceDocLink values in the artifact body, reason, summary, next actions, or evidenceRefs. Use workspace_create_directory for the grounded product root and productRoot/src when they do not exist, then use workspace_dotnet_new with template sln for the solution and the contracted app template under productRoot/src. A solution-only workspace_dotnet_new receipt does not satisfy the app scaffold requirement. When DotNetCreateProjectExecutionPlan is present, execute it in order: scaffold or verify solution/app files, write DotNetCreateProjectScript to DotNetCreateProjectScriptRef, verify that .ps1 ref, run it with workspace_pwsh_run_script and DotNetCreateProjectSideEffectManifest, then read back the solution and app project file. Do not write the primary steps/create-dotnet-project.md artifact or Completed outcome before the workspace_pwsh_run_script receipt exists; if a retry diagnostic says that receipt is missing, write or verify the helper and run it instead of rerunning workspace_dotnet_new or using force=true. The ProductCompletionRequiredPaths, ProductCompletionRequiredToolReceipts, and ProductCompletionRequiredFileContentChecks launch variables are hard completion gates; do not report Completed until required paths, template receipts, the helper receipt, and the solution app-membership file-content check pass. Existing files are not enough proof: inspect and repair stale template-critical app files before handoff, especially Blazor WebAssembly Program.cs, App.razor, _Imports.razor, and PWA assets. Do not create the test project, add feature code, run dotnet build/test/run, start a browser, or default to guessed external-target paths in this step.\r                              | Every primary managed Markdown artifact must include exactly one Status line near the top before step-specific sections: `Status: Completed`, `Status: Blocked`, `Status: Failed`, `Status: WaitingApproval`, or `Status: Refused`. When a branch outcome is selected, the artifact status and finalizer status must be `Completed`, with the branch key carrying the disposition. Include an exact `Branch outcome key: <listed-key>` line in the artifact for every selected branch outcome. These lines are part of the runtime recovery contract if the provider stream fails after writing evidence.\r
